sources.title: Integrating Model Context Protocol Tools with Semantic Kernel: A Step ...
sources.snippet: This post describes how to use Model Context Protocol tools with Semantic Kernel. Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open protocol that standardizes how applications provide context to LLMs. MCP standardizes the connection between AI models and various data sources and tools.
